name: Monaco (Princely Flag)
description: A white field charged with the full achievement of the Grimaldi arms: the lozengy shield with sword-bearing friar supporters beneath the princely crown.
history: The state flag and princely banner of Monaco, used by the Prince and the government.

features.role: arms of the House of Grimaldi
features.symbolism: the friars recall François Grimaldi, who took Monaco's fortress in 1297 disguised as a monk
